settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.text: Clear answers about ordering, delivery, payment, returns and our products.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Your CLIMORA order will be delivered through our courier partner, Aramex. Estimated delivery is 5–10 business days, subject to order processing and courier collection.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: When your order is handed to Aramex you’ll receive a shipping confirmation email. When tracking is available for your shipment, the tracking details are included in that email.

settings.question: Do you deliver across South Africa?
settings.answer: We deliver to addresses serviced by Aramex. Enter your address at checkout to see the delivery options available for your location.

settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: Delivery costs are calculated and shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Contact us as soon as possible. If your order hasn’t been processed for courier collection yet, we’ll do our best to help.

settings.question: Is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Yes. Payments are processed through Shopify’s encrypted checkout. The payment methods available to you are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: The payment methods available are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Will I receive an order confirmation?
settings.answer: Yes — an order confirmation is emailed to you as soon as your order is placed.

settings.question: Where can I find product specifications?
settings.answer: Each product page has a Specifications section with the verified details for that product.

settings.question: How do I choose the right FrostLayer size?
settings.answer: Select the size that matches your mattress. If you’re unsure, contact us before ordering.

settings.question: How do I charge SolarFlow?
settings.answer: SolarFlow is rechargeable with solar charging capability. Please follow the charging instructions supplied with your fan.

settings.question: How should I care for IceSoft and FrostLayer?
settings.answer: Follow the care label supplied with your product.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Yes, subject to our policy. See Returns & Refunds for eligibility, timeframes and how to start a return.

settings.question: My order arrived damaged — what should I do?
settings.answer: Please contact us as soon as possible with your order number and photos of the damage, and we’ll help you resolve it.

settings.question: How do I contact you?
settings.answer: Use the form on our Contact page and we’ll reply as soon as possible during business hours.
